name: Digby
about: Digby: a wombat who loves digging. A red beanie. Cut from the canvas drawing by tools/make_cast_rigs.py; do not edit by hand.

nod.about: An everyday log was saved: one small happy bounce.

greet.about: Hello: a wave, held at the top, eyebrows up.

celebrate.about: A milestone: two hops with her arms up. The only big reaction; keep it rare.

wake.about: A sleep ended: a long stretch with her eyes shut, then wide awake.

walk.about: Walking on the spot, a waddle from side to side. Goes round until told to stop.

greet-left.about: Hello: a wave, held at the top, eyebrows up.

oh.about: Oh! A small start, hands to her cheeks and clear of her bill, eyes wide. The one time her hands are in front of her head.

read.about: Reading: a book held open at her chest, eyes down on it, a page turned now and then. Goes round until stopped.

bubbles.about: Making bubbles: a wand held up in her right hand and swept slowly through the air, her eyes on it. No blowing: the bubbles come off the wand as it moves. Goes round until stopped.
